import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
def uni(q, size=500):
    url=(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query={q}"
         "&fields=accession,organism_name,length,sequence&format=tsv&size="+str(size))
    r=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=180); open("/tmp/u.tsv","w").write(r.text)
    return pd.read_csv("/tmp/u.tsv",sep="\t")
def seq(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
def nw(a,b,match=2,mis=-1,gap=-5):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    M[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; M[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; P[1:,0]=1; P[0,1:]=2
    bl=list(b)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]; prev=M[i-1]; cur=M[i]; pr=P[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=match if ai==bl[j-1] else mis
            d=prev[j-1]+s; u=prev[j]+gap; l=cur[j-1]+gap
            if d>=u and d>=l: cur[j]=d; pr[j]=0
            elif u>=l: cur[j]=u; pr[j]=1
            else: cur[j]=l; pr[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; out=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return out[::-1]

def acidity_profile(ref_seq, positions, df, minid=0.35, maxn=250):
    acidic=set("DE"); keep=[]; cols={p:[] for p in positions}
    for _,row in df.iterrows():
        s=row.Sequence
        if not isinstance(s,str) or s==ref_seq or len(s)>2.2*len(ref_seq) or len(s)<0.5*len(ref_seq): continue
        pr=nw(ref_seq,s); idt=np.mean([ref_seq[i]==s[j] for i,j in pr])
        if idt<minid: continue
        mp={i:j for i,j in pr}; keep.append(idt)
        for p in positions:
            j=mp.get(p-1); cols[p].append(s[j] if j is not None else "-")
        if len(keep)>=maxn: break
    rows=[]
    for p in positions:
        c=cols[p]
        rows.append(dict(pos=p, ref=ref_seq[p-1], n=len(c),
                         pct_acidic=round(100*np.mean([x in acidic for x in c]),1),
                         pct_identical=round(100*np.mean([x==ref_seq[p-1] for x in c]),1)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), np.mean(keep), len(keep)

# human TIM22 (Q9Y584) cavity-equivalent positions from the structural mapping
tim22_pos=[66,75,76,78,79,80,83,128,129,130,132,133,134,136,137,140,144,155,162,182,185,186,189,190]
TIM22=seq("Q9Y584")
df22=uni("gene:TIMM22+AND+taxonomy_id:33208")
p22,mid22,n22=acidity_profile(TIM22, tim22_pos, df22)
print("TIMM22 metazoan orthologs used: %d (mean id %.2f)"%(n22,mid22))
print(p22.to_string(index=False))

TIM17A=seq("Q99595")
df17=uni("gene:TIMM17A+AND+taxonomy_id:33208")
# map yeast Tim17 cavity onto human TIMM17A by sequence (close homologs)
T17y=seq("P39515")
pr=nw(T17y,TIM17A); mp={i:j for i,j in pr}
cav_y=[7,16,17,19,20,21,24,64,65,66,68,69,70,72,73,76,80,91,98,118,121,122,125,126]
tim17a_pos=[mp[p-1]+1 for p in cav_y if mp.get(p-1) is not None]
print("\nyeast->human TIMM17A cavity positions:", list(zip(cav_y,[TIM17A[q-1]+str(q) for q in tim17a_pos])))
p17,mid17,n17=acidity_profile(TIM17A, tim17a_pos, df17)
print("TIMM17A metazoan orthologs used: %d (mean id %.2f)"%(n17,mid17))
print(p17.to_string(index=False))

# TIMMDC1 (recompute quickly, reuse earlier numbers by recomputation on fewer orthologs)
TIMMDC1=seq("Q9NPL8")
dfT=uni("gene:TIMMDC1+AND+taxonomy_id:33208")
cav_T=[80,82,83,84,87,141,142,143,145,146,147,149,150,153,157,168,175,195,198,199,202,203]
pT,midT,nT=acidity_profile(TIMMDC1, cav_T, dfT)
print("\nTIMMDC1 metazoan orthologs used: %d (mean id %.2f)"%(nT,midT))
print(pT.to_string(index=False))

summary=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(protein="TIMM17A (human)", n_orthologs=n17, n_positions=len(p17),
      positions_acidic_in_majority=int((p17.pct_acidic>50).sum()), mean_pct_acidic=round(p17.pct_acidic.mean(),1)),
 dict(protein="TIMM22 (human)", n_orthologs=n22, n_positions=len(p22),
      positions_acidic_in_majority=int((p22.pct_acidic>50).sum()), mean_pct_acidic=round(p22.pct_acidic.mean(),1)),
 dict(protein="TIMMDC1 (human)", n_orthologs=nT, n_positions=len(pT),
      positions_acidic_in_majority=int((pT.pct_acidic>50).sum()), mean_pct_acidic=round(pT.pct_acidic.mean(),1)),
])
print("\n=== Acidic character of the cavity lining across metazoan orthologs ===")
print(summary.to_string(index=False))
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
a=int((p17.pct_acidic>50).sum())+int((p22.pct_acidic>50).sum()); b=len(p17)+len(p22)-a
c=int((pT.pct_acidic>50).sum()); d=len(pT)-c
print("Fisher (Tim17A+Tim22 vs TIMMDC1), acidic-majority positions: %d/%d vs %d/%d, p=%.4f"%(a,a+b,c,c+d,fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]],alternative='greater')[1]))

# pLDDT of the TIMMDC1 AlphaFold model
open("/tmp/af.pdb","wb").write(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9NPL8-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=60).content)
pl={}
for L in open("/tmp/af.pdb"):
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(L[22:26])]=float(L[60:66])
pls=pd.Series(pl)
print("\nTIMMDC1 AlphaFold pLDDT: whole %.1f | TM core 80-230 %.1f | cavity positions %.1f"%(
    pls.mean(), pls.loc[80:230].mean(), pls.loc[cav_T].mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.5))
ax[0].plot(pls.index, pls.values, color="#444", lw=1.2)
ax[0].axhspan(70,90,color="#cfe8f3",alpha=.5); ax[0].axhspan(90,100,color="#9ecae1",alpha=.5)
ax[0].scatter(cav_T, pls.loc[cav_T], color="#d1495b", zorder=3, s=28, label="cavity-equivalent positions")
ax[0].axvspan(80,230,color="#ffe9b3",alpha=.35)
ax[0].set_xlabel("TIMMDC1 residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax[0].legend(frameon=False)
ax[0].set_title("Model confidence (shaded: TM core 80-230)")
labels=["TIMM17A","TIMM22","TIMMDC1"]; vals=[p17.pct_acidic.mean(),p22.pct_acidic.mean(),pT.pct_acidic.mean()]
ax[1].bar(labels, vals, color=["#2e86ab","#5f9ea0","#d1495b"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[1].text(i,v+0.6,"%.1f%%"%v,ha="center")
ax[1].set_ylabel("mean %% of orthologs with Asp/Glu\nat cavity-lining positions")
ax[1].set_title("Acidic cavity lining is absent from TIMMDC1 orthologs")
for a_ in ax: a_.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
